name: Kitnap
description: Gift a card. Enchant creature. When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature. If the gift wasn't promised, put three stun counters on it. You control enchanted creature.
notes: Found and fixed 4 real bugs on this one card: (1) Mode$Continuous+GainControl$ (the defining 'You control enchanted creature' effect) had zero handling at all -- added as a `becomes` role node, same real fact as the one-shot GainControl effect elsewhere. (2) Defined$Enchanted ('tap enchanted creature') resolved to the meaningless literal thing:"enchanted" instead of the coarse type 'creature' -- fixed in both Tap/Untap and PutCounter. (3) PutCounter had ZERO gift-condition handling at all (only Pump/PumpAll/ChangeZone did) -- added via the new shared giftGateFact helper. (4) That same helper fixed a latent polarity bug: EVERY existing gift-condition call site hardcoded "gift_promised" regardless of ConditionCompare$'s actual polarity, so this card's real EQ0 ("if the gift WASN'T promised") would have been mislabeled backwards as gift_promised -- now correctly shows gift_not_promised. Also extended Affected$ resolution for Card.EquippedBy/EnchantedBy (base 'Card' hit coarseType's 'any' rule, losing real precision) to resolve to 'creature'. All verified directly in the regenerated packet. In blb-success.json.
